name: layered-server-architecture
explain: A four-tier MCP architecture isolates protocol handling from domain business logic, allowing domain services to be reused across MCP and REST interfaces without duplication.
steps: Define authoritative domain services with business rules and multi-tenant checks. || Implement a thin MCP protocol adapter translating JSON-RPC requests to domain service calls. || Expose the same domain service through an HTTP controller to prevent business logic drift.
expect: Layered MCP server architecture and domain service isolation verified successfully.

name: remote-auth-context-propagation
explain: Remote MCP servers authenticate via Bearer JWTs with audience checks to prevent confused-deputy attacks, propagating identity into request context.
steps: Validate JWT signatures, expiration, and server audience to defeat confused-deputy vulnerabilities. || Propagate caller identity via asynchronous context variables across tool dispatch boundaries. || Enforce verified tenant context in data queries, rejecting model-injected parameter spoofing.
expect: Remote MCP authentication, audience verification, and context propagation verified successfully.

name: tool-error-taxonomy
explain: A structured domain error taxonomy reports expected business failures with isError: true and actionable guidance for LLM self-correction while redacting internal crash details.
steps: Define specialized domain exception classes for validation, missing resources, and rate limits. || Map domain exceptions to MCP CallToolResult payloads with isError: true and recovery guidance. || Redact internal stack traces and server secrets from unexpected crash payloads.
expect: MCP tool error modeling and domain taxonomy verified successfully.

name: idempotent-write-human-confirmation
explain: Write tools enforce business-level idempotency keys, optimistic revision concurrency, and two-phase signed human confirmation for destructive mutations.
steps: Deduplicate retries using idempotency keys and reject parameter mismatch conflicts. || Guard concurrent record mutations using optimistic revision checks. || Generate HMAC-signed approval tokens for destructive operations and verify human authorization before execution.
expect: Idempotent write tools and two-phase human confirmation verified successfully.

name: concurrency-retries-telemetry
explain: MCP server resilience combines semaphore concurrency bounds, exponential backoff with jitter for transient retries, and sanitized OpenTelemetry distributed tracing.
steps: Bound active concurrent tool executions using an asyncio Semaphore. || Apply exponential backoff with jitter to transient connection faults while failing fast on deterministic domain errors. || Record OpenTelemetry spans capturing tool duration, tenant ID, and status while omitting private payloads.
expect: MCP concurrency bounds, retry backoff, and OpenTelemetry spans verified successfully.

name: contract-tests-schema-evolution
explain: Automated contract test suites verify bounded input constraints, tenant isolation, and backward-compatible schema evolution across release versions.
steps: Enforce strict parameter bounds and capped response payload sizes on tool implementations. || Execute automated contract tests across golden paths, boundary limits, and tenant boundaries. || Verify backward compatibility rules (SemVer) when evolving tool input schemas across releases.
expect: MCP contract tests, bounded limits, and schema evolution verified successfully.
